summary: 31 features and 10 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • plugin: add normal-session preset task plugin (4a590a1)
  • plugin: update ui-master preset task configuration (121d9eb)
  • plugin: update claude-md-update preset task content (0c61259)
  • auto-task: add auto-task session creation endpoint (fcf23f0)
  • session: preserve metadata and working directory in session creation (ed62b12)
  • frontend-config: add visible property to session creation order entries (f748524)
  • preset-tasks: add CLAUDE.md update preset task (6f5fc72)
  • pi: support session ID persistence across provider instances (54581c5)
  • frontend-config: add session creation order support (b88c125)
  • git: add HTTP endpoints for batch git operations (76d91d5)
  • git: implement batch push, pull, and rebase operations (493ad23)
  • git: add batch operation DTOs for push, pull, and rebase (9eeb69b)
  • preset-tasks: add icon support for preset task catalog (d8f665d)
  • orleans: add active processing token scope management for session cancellation (c71818e)
  • auto-tasks: support vault-targeted preset tasks and reject legacy research prompts (d6fba90)
  • preset-tasks: add output selection metadata and improve caching (873d27f)
  • preset-tasks: add research-investigation plugin and remove legacy prompts (50fa71c)

HagiCode-org/web

  • selectors: add scrollbar visibility control to selector components (ecc012b)
  • git: add sync state icons to repository list (05a8ce9)
  • session: add file-pen-line and message-circle icon mappings (011f3de)
  • session: add per-entry visibility flag to session creation order (38ca66f)
  • repository: prioritize out-of-sync repositories in sorting (2c1268f)
  • preset-task: add default hero and skill gallery integration (8d3268c)
  • preset-task: add hero selection floating panel and recent heroes (833c418)
  • settings: integrate session creation order settings (4dcf6ee)
  • services: add session creation order bootstrap (0bfc3d4)
  • conversation: add conversation header and history components (84024e2)
  • session: add session creation order management (be2b1fc)
  • preset-task: add icon field support and flexible icon resolution (a4b3f02)
  • session: add kanban layout variant for session creation buttons (5c3f0c8)
  • preset-task: add vault output selection and research direction support (a5712b8)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • skills: add fallback uninstall for missing Skills CLI (ffdaa14)
  • preset-tasks: disable icon property loading (58c633e)

HagiCode-org/web

  • preset-task: improve layout and scrollbar visibility in scope tabs (200a789)
  • proposal: align selector flex classes for proper overflow handling (462c884)
  • session: hide chat action in session list header (913cb18)
  • proposal: improve repository selector overflow and scroll behavior (9304709)
  • preset-task: respect required flag for repository selectors (c488a86)
  • preset-task: correct hero override handling in session creation (3413d9d)
  • panels: update ProposalSessionPanel for detail drawer (cd289b3)
  • sessions: handle research preset task metadata and executor mapping (b7aa82f)
